songs.description: “Send My Love (To Your New Lover)” is an upbeat pop track by Adele from her album 25. The song explores acceptance, emotional growth, and moving forward after the end of a relationship. Rather than dwelling solely on heartbreak, it presents a confident sense of closure and freedom, reflecting the decision to let go of the past and wish a former partner well. Its energetic rhythm and expressive vocal performance give the track a lighter and more empowering character while retaining Adele’s emotionally driven songwriting style.

songs.title: Love In The Dark
songs.description: “Love in the Dark” is an emotionally powerful ballad by Adele from her album 25. The song explores the difficult decision to end a relationship despite the presence of genuine love and affection. Through themes of heartbreak, acceptance, emotional honesty, and letting go, it portrays the realization that love alone may not be enough to sustain a relationship. Adele’s expressive vocals and delicate arrangement create a deeply reflective portrayal of separation, maturity, and the courage required to say goodbye.

songs.title: A Whole New World (End Title)
songs.lyrics:
I can show you the world
Shining, shimmering, splendid
Tell me, princess, now when did
You last let your heart decide?
I can open your eyes
Take you wonder by wonder
Over, sideways and under
On a magic carpet ride

A whole new world
A new fantastic point of view
No one to tell us, "no"
Or where to go
Or say we're only dreaming

A whole new world
A dazzling place I never knew
But when I'm way up here
It's crystal clear
That now I'm in a whole new world with you
(Now I'm in a whole new world with you)

Unbelievable sights
Indescribable feeling
Soaring, tumbling, freewheeling
Through an endless diamond sky

A whole new world
(Don't you dare close your eyes)
A hundred thousand things to see
(Hold your breath, it gets better)
I'm like a shooting star
I've come so far
I can't go back to where I used to be

A whole new world
(Every turn, a surprise)
With new horizons to pursue
(Every moment, red-letter)
I'll chase them anywhere
There's time to spare
Let me share this whole new world with you

A whole new world
(A whole new world)
That's where we'll be
(That's where we'll be)
A thrilling chase
(A wondrous place)
For you and me

songs.title: Yes He Lives
songs.lyrics:
(Come on across this room sing it out)
On a hill for sinners (C'mon)
His body broken
A King forsaken
As He hung on that cross

The veil in pieces
The temple shaken
They mourned the Saviour
But it wasn't for long (Come on lift your voice, He lives)

Oh He lives (C'mon)
He's risen from the grave
Victorious our Saviour reigns
Oh yes He reigns

He rose
The stone is rolled away
Forever our Redeemer lives
Oh yes He lives

(In the silence)

There in the silence
It wasn't over
Oh our Redeemer
Was getting ready to rise (C'mon)

And on that morning
They came to find Him
But that tomb was empty
'Cause He is alive

But that tomb was empty
'Cause He is alive
(He lives)

Oh He lives
He's risen from the grave
Victorious our Saviour reigns
Oh yes He reigns

He rose
The stone is rolled away
Forever our Redeemer lives
Oh yes He lives
(Come on give Jesus an ovation in this place. Come on lift your voice!)

Jesus Christ crucified
Through His death there is life
By the blood of the Lamb
We have been forgiven

Our debt has been paid
There is grace upon grace
Only one Name that saves
And His Name is Jesus (Come on lift your voice)

Jesus Christ crucified
Through His death there is life
By the blood of the Lamb
We have been forgiven

Our debt has been paid
There is grace upon grace
Only one Name that saves
And His Name is Jesus

Victorious our Saviour reigns
(Hey) Oh yes He reigns

He rose

Oh yes He lives

Oh He lives

Oh yes He reigns

He rose

Forever our Redeemer lives
Oh yes He lives

We have been forgiven

songs.title: Yahweh Great I AM
songs.lyrics:
We approach the presence of God
With a humble, confident heart
Where we're standing now
Is Your holy ground

We approach the presence of God
Filled with wonder
Of who You are
In this holy place
God we seek Your face
In this holy place
We're forever changed
(Come on, we respond)

All glory forever
Be unto Your Name
Each breath that we take
Was made to proclaim
Forever Yahweh

To God in the highest
(He's) Unrivalled in fame
All honour and praise
All power and strength
Forever Yahweh

We approach the presence of God
Where You are
Your people respond
Now with shouts of praise (Come on)
All for Your great Name
God we're full of faith
All for Your great Name

All glory forever
Be unto Your Name
Each breath that we take
Was made to proclaim

songs.title: All This Future
songs.lyrics:
Dark skies bright eyes
All this future
The music never died
And despite all the rumours
There's life in these bones
Best believe the best is yet to come

Open up the doors
Watch the tables turn
Let the bride ring in the sound
Of a brand-new world
Better let the night know
Our hope doesn't set with the sun

The light of the world is here
Shining now in all this future
Stir up the life in these bones
Don't let the fire go cold now

The light of the world is here
Shining now in all this future
Stir up the life in these bones
And don't let the fire go out

End times headlines
All this future
Apocalypse wow
Watch the fear turn to wonder
The times will wash out
But Your Word lasts forever
So here's to the end of the world
As we know it

Young man old man
Don't quit dreaming
And don't go quiet now
Prophecy all you daughters
The world spins left right
But our hope runs so much higher

The light of the world is here
Shining now in all this future
Stir up the life in these bones
Don't let the fire go cold now

The light of the world is here
Shining now in all this future
Stir up the life in these bones
And don't let the fire go out

(I won't be afraid)
I see a holy horizon
As it breaks through the night
In the light of grace

(And I won't be afraid)
I see the promise of heaven
As it gathers the skies
In the latter rain

(I won't be afraid)
I see the earth drenched in future
As You pour out Your spirit
In the end of days

(I won't be afraid)
I see a brand-new creation
As the Kingdom awakens
The sound of praise

Dark skies bright eyes
All this future
The Kingdom is live
And it's all to discover
There's life in our song
Best believe the best is yet to come

Turn the music up
Watch the mountains fall
Let the streets ring in the sound
Of a brand-new world
Better let the night know
Our hope doesn't set with the sun

songs.lyrics:

Some place wilder than the safety of these old familiar shores
'Cause I know there's so much more
And I'm desperate to explore
All the grace beyond these shores

Teach my soul not to fear the darkness
Teach my heart to fully lean on Your cross for comfort
Bind my step to Your steadfast promise

'Cause I know there's so much more
And I'm desperate to explore
All the grace beyond these shores

I got the hope of heaven running through my bones
And the blood of Jesus in my veins
I got a soul on fire in the Holy Ghost
And all my strength is in Your name
'Cause now this world holds nothing on this grace I know
And I know Your love will never fail
And if there's deeper waters to this life You hold
Sink or swim, I'll never be afraid

songs.title: Show Me Your Heart
songs.lyrics:
Wide awake
In the dead of night
While the world comes apart
You keep watch
When my vision is blurry
And my thoughts run afar

You step in
When the wolves come prowling
And the thieves come to steal
'Cause You don't sleep
When my world spins in darkness
And I can't tell what's real

Show me Your heart
'Cause I need a Father
Show me Your love

Show me Your scars

Show me Your heart
'Cause I just need a place I can run
And fall into the arms of my Father

You don't hide
From my heavy mess

You don't run

No You never lose heart

songs.title: Blown Away
songs.lyrics:
Oh, Troubled Messiah
You prayed through the night
Unbearable sorrow
The world on Your mind

Betrayed by the kiss of a friend
You were taken
By Your own free will
Rejected and disowned
By those You came to heal
Stripped of Your clothes, You were mocked, You were beaten
Made a King of fools
A crown of sorrow driven deep into Your brow
Yet You made no sound

What You went through to love me
I'll never understand
What blows my mind away is
You love me as I am

They called for Barabbas
A King for a thief
Parading Your kindness
Like rags through the streets

Draped with the weight of the world on Your shoulders
As You climbed that hill
A burden far too great for flesh and bone to bear
You stretched out Your arms as You welcomed those Roman nails
Your body frail
The very hands that shaped the world hung up to bleed
Lifted on high, crucified Him who knew no sin
The Nazarene
The Son of Man, the Lamb of God, Emmanuel
Given to die

What You went through to love me
I'll never understand
What blows my mind away is
You love me as I am

Precious Redeemer
Lamb that was slain
Hope for the hopeless
Lifter of shame
Friend to the sinner
Grace to my soul
Death is defeated
Now my sin is gone
And I'm blown away
Yeah, I'm blown away

Crushed by the weight of the world that You came to save
You took my place
Your blood as rivers flowing freely to the ground
Yielding Your spirit, You let out a holy cry
As You gave Your life
"Oh, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?"
Oh, my Jesus Christ

What You went through to love me
I'll never understand
What blows my mind away is
You'd do it all again

songs.title: RUN 2 U
songs.lyrics:
I've carried mountains on my shoulders
Tried to fight the night alone
But every time my strength was over
You were calling me back home
I felt the breaking in my spirit
Felt the weight of all my wrongs
But You met me in the ruins
Turned my weakness into song

You take the shattered
Make it whole again
You take the hurting
Hold me like a friend

So I run to You
To the one who never leaves me
To the love that always frees me
Jesus, it's You
Every battle, every burden
Every wound that I've been nursing
You pull me through
Lord, I run to You

I've seen Your mercy in the morning
Heard Your whisper in the rain
When my past was loud as thunder
You were louder than my pain
You are the healer of my failures
You are the rest when I can't sleep
You are the peace inside the chaos
You're the promise I can keep

You take the broken
Shape me with Your hands
You take the hopeless
Teach me how to stand

Oh, so I run to You
To the one who never leaves me
To the love that always frees me
Jesus, it's You (Jesus, it's You)
Every battle, every burden
Every wound that I've been nursing
You pull me through
Lord, I run to You

When the night is heavy
When my heart is tired
You are my refuge
And You are my fire
Every breath I'm breathing
And every truth I hold
Is rooted in Your mercy
That never lets me go
That never lets me go

So I run to You (so I run to You)
To the one who always hears me
To the grace that draws me near You
Oh Jesus, it's You
Every valley, every sorrow
Every fear about tomorrow
You carry me through
Lord, I run to You

songs.lyrics:
Hark the herald angels sing
Glory to the newborn King
Peace on earth and mercy mild
God and sinners reconciled

Joyful, all ye nations rise
Join the triumph of the skies
With angelic host proclaim
Christ is born in Bethlehem
Hark the herald angels sing
Glory to the newborn King

Christ by highest Heaven adored
Christ the everlasting Lord
Late in time behold Him come
Offspring of a virgin's womb

Veiled in flesh, the Godhead see
Hail the incarnate deity
Pleased as man with man to dwell
Jesus our Emmanuel
Hark the herald angels sing
Glory to the newborn King

Hail the Heaven born Prince of peace
Hail the Son of righteousness
Light and life to all He brings
Risen with healing in His wings

Mild He lays His glory by
Born that man no more may die
Born to raise the sons of earth
Born to give them second birth

Hark the herald angels sing
Glory to the newborn King

songs.lyrics:
A thousand generations falling down in worship
To sing the song of ages to the Lamb
And all who've gone before us and all who will believe
Will sing the song of ages to the Lamb

Your name is the highest
Your name is the greatest
Your name stands above them all
All thrones and dominions
All powers and positions
Your name stands above them all

And the angels cry holy
All creation cries holy
You are lifted high, holy
Holy forever

If you've been forgiven and if you've been redeemed
Sing the song forever to the Lamb
If you walk in freedom and if you bear His name
Sing the song forever to the Lamb
We'll sing the song forever and amen

And the angels cry holy
All creation cries holy
You are lifted high, holy
Holy forever
Hear Your people sing holy
To the King of kings, holy
You will always be holy
Holy forever

Your name stands above them all

Jesus

songs.albumTitle: Good News Of Great Joy (Christmas Songs Of Worship)
songs.albumName: Good News Of Great Joy (Christmas Songs Of Worship)
songs.lyrics:
Joy to the world, the Lord is come
Let earth receive her King
Let every heart prepare Him room
And Heaven and nature sing
And Heaven and nature sing
And Heaven, and Heaven and nature sing
Joy to the world, the Savior reigns
That all their songs employ
While fields and floods, rocks, hills and plains
Repeat the sounding joy
Repeat the sounding joy
Repeat, repeat the sounding joy
Here we go
Joy, unspeakable joy
And overflowing where no tongue can tell
Joy, unspeakable joy
Rises in my soul, never lets me go
He rules the world with truth and grace
And makes the nations prove
The glories of His righteousness
And wonders of His love
And wonders of His love
And wonders, wonders of His love
Joy
Joy, unspeakable joy
And overflowing where no tongue can tell
Joy, unspeakable joy
Rises in my soul, never lets me go

songs.lyrics:
Hey, please let me in
I've been standing here all night
Mosquitoes bite between my eyes
Please, open your door
I hate to see that all my friends
Are laughing at the way
You treated me
Woh, yeah, yeah, yeah

It's been a long, long time
And you're still in my mind
I've never felt of it this way
My head is filled with things to say
Tell me now will you give me a chance
I'm going crazy for you babe
Whatever comes along I'll think of you
Woh, yeah, yeah, yeah

Shame, you're playing so tough
It's hard for you to understand
Why don't you just give me a chance
Please, take me in
We'll never know until we try
We might end up with feelings that's for real
Woh, yeah, yeah, yeah

All my life I kept on searching for someone
But your thoughts keep flowing back to me, oh
Staying unmindful of the strong winds
That's forcing me to stay away from you

But still standing here you see
I'm patiently waiting for the sun
I wish I could get near you, oh, oh
You know that I've been
Patiently waiting for the sun
I wish I could get near you
Feel you, see you
Hear you say you're mine

songs.lyrics:
Nung araw kay tamis ng ating buhay
Puno ng saya at ng kulay
'Di mauulit muli
Ang oras kapag hinayaang lumipas
Madarama mo hanggang bukas
'Di mababawi muli

Ang dami-daming bagay na hindi naman kailangan
Kung pwede lang bawasan natin ang mga tampuhan
Hindi mo lang alam, hindi mo pa nararanasan
Kahapon sana natin, 'di mo na pinahirapan
Patawad muli
'Di na muli

Ang oras kapag hinayaang lumipas
Madarama mo hanggang bukas
'Di mababawi muli

At natapos ang himas ng sandali
'Di kukubli aking tinig
Nang lumipas na't 'di man lang nasabi
Salamat hanggang sa muli

Ang dami-daming bagay na hindi naman kailangan
Kung pwede lang bawasan natin ang mga tampuhan
Hindi mo lang alam, hindi mo pa nararanasan
Kahapon sana natin 'di mo na pinahirapan
Patawad muli
'Di na muli

Binawi ang buhay mo nang walang sabi
Binubulong ko sa sarili
Mahal kita hanggang sa huli

Mahal ko hanggang sa huli

songs.title: Where Is the Love?
songs.description: The monumental Grammy-nominated breakthrough single featuring Justin Timberlake, delivering an impassioned social anthem against war, racism, and inequality.
songs.lyrics:
What's wrong with the world, mama
People livin' like they ain't got no mamas
I think the whole world's addicted to the drama
Only attracted to things that'll bring you trauma

songs.title: Shut Up
songs.description: A punchy and theatrical back-and-forth anthem between will.i.am and Fergie that topped charts in over a dozen countries worldwide.
songs.lyrics:
Shut up, just shut up, shut up
Shut up, just shut up, shut up
Shut it up, just shut up

songs.title: Let's Get It Started
songs.description: The Grammy Award-winning global party starter and official NBA Playoffs anthem celebrated for its unstoppable energy.
songs.lyrics:
Let's get it started in here
Let's get it started in here
And the beat goes on and on and on

songs.title: Hey Mama
songs.description: A fiery dancehall-infused hip-hop crossover featuring infectious verses from will.i.am, Taboo, and Fergie.
songs.lyrics:
Hey mama, this that beat that makes ya move ya mama
Hey mama, hey mama, hey mama

songs.title: Pump It
songs.description: An adrenaline-fueled classic sampling Dick Dale's surf-rock version of "Misirlou", recognized instantly worldwide.
songs.lyrics:
Ha ha ha, and pump it (louder!)
Pump it (louder!)
Turn up the radio, blast your stereo right

songs.title: Don't Phunk with My Heart
songs.description: Grammy Award-winning lead single sampling vintage Bollywood cinema with a relentless funky groove.
songs.lyrics:
No, no, no, no, don't phunk with my heart
I wonder if I take you home, would you still be in love, baby?

songs.title: My Humps
songs.description: Grammy Award-winning global pop-culture phenomenon starring Fergie's playful vocals.
songs.lyrics:
What you gonna do with all that junk?
All that junk inside your trunk?
I'ma get, get, get, get you drunk
Get you love drunk off my hump

songs.title: Boom Boom Pow
songs.description: The futuristic electro-hop anthem that spent 12 consecutive weeks at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.
songs.lyrics:
Gotta get that
Boom boom boom (gotta get that)
Boom boom boom (gotta get that)
That boom boom pow

songs.title: I Gotta Feeling
songs.description: Produced by David Guetta, this is one of the biggest digital singles in music history, spending 14 consecutive weeks at #1.
songs.lyrics:
I gotta feeling that tonight's gonna be a good night
That tonight's gonna be a good night
That tonight's gonna be a good, good night

songs.title: Meet Me Halfway
songs.description: An ethereal synth-pop and electro ballad driven by Fergie's soaring vocal hook that topped charts across Europe and Australia.
songs.lyrics:
Can you meet me halfway, right at the borderline?
That's where I'm gonna wait, for you
I'll be lookin' out, night and day

songs.title: The Time (Dirty Bit)
songs.description: High-octane electro-house anthem interpolating "(I've Had) The Time of My Life" from Dirty Dancing.
songs.lyrics:
I've had the time of my life
And I've never felt this way before
Yes I swear, it's the truth
And I owe it all to you

songs.title: Just Can't Get Enough
songs.description: An emotional electronic ballad and worldwide smash hit dedicated in solidarity to the people of Japan.
songs.lyrics:
Mega love, mega dream
Can't you see what I mean?
Boy, I think about you every second of the day

songs.title: At Night I Think of You
songs.description: Wild Orchid's dazzling Billboard Hot 100 debut single featuring golden 90s dance-pop grooves and lush three-part vocal harmonies.
songs.lyrics:
At night I think of you, I want to be with you
And everything you do, boy, keeps me wanting you

songs.title: Talk to Me
songs.description: Smooth, soulful R&B groove with Stacy Ferguson's trademark soaring vocals, charting across Billboard pop and dance rankings.
songs.lyrics:
Talk to me baby, tell me what's on your mind
Don't keep it inside, talk to me

songs.title: Supernatural
songs.description: An infectious, upbeat summer dance-pop track with soaring harmonies and vibrant production.
songs.lyrics:
It's something supernatural, the way you make me feel inside
It's magic, oh boy, you take me for a ride

songs.title: Be Mine
songs.description: The polished lead single from their second album Oxygen, showcasing intricate vocal phrasing and smooth late-90s R&B rhythms.
songs.lyrics:
Won't you be mine, be mine tonight
Let's make this feeling last forever, hold me tight

songs.title: Stumble
songs.description: A punchy, edgy dance-pop track with electronic elements from their final studio album Fire.
songs.lyrics:
I stumble into your arms again
Can't help the way I feel, where do we begin?

songs.title: ceilings
songs.description: The platinum-certified global sensation with a devastating final twist and soaring cinematic crescendo.
songs.lyrics:
Ceilings, plaster
Can't you just make it move a little faster?
Lovely, to be sitting here with you
You're in my bed, it's half-past two

songs.title: doomsday
songs.description: A theatrical, biting indie-rock anthem featuring dramatic funeral metaphors and explosive drums.
songs.lyrics:
Doomsday is close at hand
I'll book the marching band
To play as you speak

songs.title: erase me (feat. Jacob Collier)
songs.description: An intricate, driving pop collaboration with multi-instrumentalist Jacob Collier exploring post-breakup loneliness.
songs.lyrics:
I've been going out with someone new
Just to see if I can stand to look at him and not see you

songs.title: Older
songs.description: The title track of her third album, exploring the weight of growing up with sparse, haunting piano and acoustic guitar.
songs.lyrics:
Over and over, a watch on a wrist
Moments in time that I know that I'll miss
I thought it'd be different, I thought I'd be brave

songs.title: I Guess
songs.description: A beautifully arranged live-to-tape indie folk track featuring brass swells and introspective lyrics.
songs.lyrics:
I guess it's all about timing
I guess it's all about how you hold it together
When the weather changes

songs.title: Only Love Can Hurt Like This
songs.description: Paloma Faith's multi-platinum signature masterpiece written by Diane Warren, featuring one of the most iconic, soul-stirring vocal performances of the decade.
songs.lyrics:
I tell myself I don't care that much
But I feel like I die till I feel your touch
Only love, only love can hurt like this
Only love can hurt like this

songs.title: Picking Up the Pieces
songs.description: The soaring, dramatic orchestral soul anthem that broke into the UK top 10 and defined her critically acclaimed Fall to Grace era.
songs.lyrics:
Do you think of her when you're with me?
Are you picking up the pieces that she left behind?
I'm picking up the pieces

songs.title: Can't Rely on You
songs.description: A sassy, funk-heavy collaboration produced by Pharrell Williams that brought retro 70s soul and disco into the modern pop era.
songs.lyrics:
I can't rely on you, no, no
I can't rely on you
You say you love me, but you never follow through

songs.title: Crybaby
songs.description: The groove-infused disco-pop anthem encouraging emotional openness and vulnerability, leading her first UK #1 album.
songs.lyrics:
Oh, real men cry, yeah, they cry, cry, cry
You don't have to keep it inside
Don't be afraid to be a crybaby

songs.title: How You Leave a Man
songs.description: A cinematic, unapologetic rock-pop divorce anthem with thundering production and fierce, triumphant vocals.
songs.lyrics:
This is how you leave a man, you pack your bags and don't turn back
You hold your head up high and take your freedom back

songs.title: Guys My Age
songs.description: The infectious, Billboard-charting breakout alt-pop hit hailed by critics for its dark synth hooks and witty take on dating maturity.
songs.lyrics:
Guys my age don't know how to touch me
They don't know how to love me good
Guys my age don't know how to treat me
Don't know what to say, don't know what to do

songs.title: Hoodie
songs.description: A bittersweet, nostalgic coming-of-age alt-pop anthem about holding onto an ex's oversized hoodie after a breakup.
songs.lyrics:
I'm still wearing your hoodie
Chewing on the strings, it still smells like you
I'm still wearing your hoodie
Even though I know we're through

songs.title: Break My Heart
songs.description: A high-voltage, electrifying pop-punk anthem driven by distorted basslines and infectious shout-along choruses.
songs.lyrics:
If you're gonna break my heart, just do it
Don't drag it out, put me through it
Just break my heart, break my heart

songs.title: Brand New Moves
songs.description: A seductive, funk-laced pop track highlighting Rena Lovelis' vocal versatility with punchy rhythm section grooves.
songs.lyrics:
I've got some brand new moves, wait till you see what I do
I've got some brand new moves for you

songs.title: Better By Myself
songs.description: An infectious anthem of self-reliance and independence celebrating the peace that comes from solitude.
songs.lyrics:
I'm better by myself, don't need nobody else
I'm dancing in my room, doing what I wanna do

songs.title: Sirena (feat. Ebe Dancel)
songs.lyrics:
Ako'y isang sirena
Kahit ano'ng sabihin nila, ako ay ubod ng ganda
Ako'y isang sirena
Kahit ano'ng gawin nila, bandera ko'y 'di tutumba

Drum na may tubig ang sinisisid
Naglalakihang mga braso, sa 'ki'y dumidikdik
Drum na may tubig ang sinisisid
Sa patagalan ng paghinga, sa 'kin kayo ay bibilib

Simula pa nang bata pa ako
Halata mo na kapag naglalaro
Kaya parang lahat ay nalilito
Magaling sa Chinese garter at piko
Mga labi ko'y pulang-pula
Sa bubble gum na sinapa
Palakad-lakad sa harapan ng salamin
Sinasabi sa sarili, "Ano'ng panama nila?"

Habang kumekembot ang bewang
Mga hikaw na gumegewang
Gamit ang pulbos na binili kay Aling Bebang
Upang matakpan ang mga pasa sa mukha
Na galing sa aking ama na tila 'di natutuwa
Sa t'wing ako'y nasisilayan, laging nalalatayan
Sa paglipas ng panahon ay 'di ko namamalayan
Na imbes na tumigas ay tila lalong lumambot
Ang puso kong mapagmahal, parang pilik-matang kulot

Ako'y isang sirena
Kahit ano'ng sabihin nila, ako ay ubod ng ganda
Ako'y isang sirena

Drum na may tubig ang sinisisid

Hanggang sa naging binata na ako
Teka muna, mali, dalaga na pala 'to
Pero bakit parang lahat ay nalilito pa rin?
Ano ba'ng mga problema n'yo?
Dahil ba ang mga kilos ko'y iba
Sa dapat makita ng inyong mata?
Sa tuwing nanonood ng liga, laging natutulala
Kahit 'di pumasok ang bola, ako'y tuwang-tuwa

Kahit kinalyo na sa tapang, kasi gano'n na lamang
Akong paluin ng tubo kahit kinakalawang
"Tama na naman, Itay, 'di na po ako pasaway
'Di ko na po isusuot ang lumang saya ni Inay"
Kapag ako'y naiiyak ay sumusugod sa ambon
Iniisip ko na lamang na baka ako'y ampon
Kasi araw-araw na lamang ay walang humpay na banat
Ang inaabot ng ganda kong pang-ilalim ng dagat

Ako'y isang sirena

Lumipas ang mga taon
Nangagsipag-asawa aking mga kapatid, lahat sila'y sumama
Nagpakalayo-layo, ni hindi makabisita
"Kakain na po, Itay, nakahanda na'ng lamesita"
Akay-akay sa paglakad, paisa-isang hakbang
Ngayo'y buto't balat ang dating matipunong katawan
Kaya sa 'yong kaarawan, susubukan kong palitan
Ang lungkot na nadarama, 'wag na po nating balikan

Kahit medyo naiinis, hindi dahil sa nagka-cancer
Kasi dahil ang tagapag-alaga mo'y naka-duster
Isang gabi, ako'y iyong tinawag, lumapit
Ako sa 'yong tabi, ika'y tumangan, kumapit
Ka sa aking kamay kahit hirap magsalita
"Anak, patawad sana sa lahat ng aking nagawa
'Di sinusukat ang tapang at ang bigote sa mukha
Dahil kung minsan, mas lalaki pa sa lalaki ang bakla"

songs.title: Magda (feat. Rico Blanco)
songs.lyrics:
Magdalena, ano'ng problema?
Bakit 'di ka makawala sa kadena?
At sa gabi-gabi, ikaw ay nasa selda
Na hanapbuhay mo ngayon
Magdalena, ano'ng problema?
Alam naman natin na dati kang nena
At sa iyong ama, ikaw ay prinsesa
Ano'ng nangyari sa 'yo?

Ito'y kwento ng isang babaeng
Tulog sa umaga, gising sa gabi
Ang kan'yang mukha'y puno ng kolorete
Sa lugar na ang ilaw ay patay sindi
Simulan na natin ang istorya

Ako'y kanyang matalik na kaibigan
Ernesto ang aking pangalan
Kwentong dapat n'yong malaman
'Wag nang magbulag-bulagan
Bakit ang nais natin ay malaman ang baho ng iba?
Pagbibigyan kita
Kilala mo ba si Magda?

Na aking kababata mula pa nang pagkabata
Kami'y lagi magkasama, mga bangkang papel sa sapa
Kan'yang ngiti, lumiliwanag ang paligid
At pag siya'y dumadaan, mga leeg ay pumipilipit
Ubod ng ganda noong siya ay nagdalaga

Tuwing kausap ko na, malimit akong tulala
Kahit may nararamdaman, pinilit kong isara
Ang bibig at pintig ng puso sa kan'ya
At sa sayawan, matapos kaming makapagtapos
Dahil pinawis ang mukha, ako'y nagpunas ng pulbos
Kahit parang hindi pantay, nagmamadaling hinila
Pinakilala niya lalaki na taga-Maynila

Magdalena, ano'ng problema?
Bakit 'di ka makawala sa kadena?
At sa gabi-gabi, ikaw ay nasa selda
Na hanapbuhay mo ngayon
Magdalena, ano'ng problema?
Alam naman natin na dati kang nena
At sa iyong ama, ikaw ay prinsesa
Ano'ng nangyari sa 'yo?

Maraming taon, ako'y nalipasan
Pinilit ko mang takasan
Bagkus ay aking nalaman
Ang tunay kong kailangan
'Di ko maibaling ang pagtingin ko sa iba
Minamahal ko s'ya
Hahanapin ko si Magda

Lumuwas habang nagdarasal na maabutan
Sa lugar na ang sabi'y kanyang pinagtatrabahuan
Nakita ko'ng larawan niya na nakadikit sa pintuan
Iba man ang kulay ng buhok, 'di ko malilimutan
Ang kan'yang mata at tamis ng kan'yang ngiti
At dahil ubod ng saya, hindi na nag-atubili

Agad pumasok sa silid pero bakit ang dilim?
Madaming lamesa't mga nag-iinumang lasing
Nang biglang nagpalakpakan, may mabagal na kanta
Sa maliit na entablado ay nakita ko na
Ako ay nagtaka, nagtanong, nagkamot
Bakit s'ya sumasayaw na sapatos lang ang suot?

Ito'y kwento ng isang babaeng
Tulog sa umaga, gising sa gabi
Ang kanyang mukha'y puno ng kolorete
Sa lugar na ang ilaw ay patay sindi
Ituloy natin ang istorya

Agad s'yang sumama sa 'kin, walang kakaba-kaba
Ang trato niya sa 'kin ay nobyo, tila kataka-taka
Bumaba sa taxi'ng pinara sa may Sta. Mesa
Parang ako'y bida sa mga sumunod na eksena
Kung ito ay panaginip, ayoko nang magising

Ngunit ako'y nanaginip, umaga na nang magising
Ang naabutan ko lamang ay may sobre sa lapag
Liham para sa 'kin na isinulat niya magdamag
Kahit gulong gulo ang isip, pinilit kong basahin
'Di malilimutan ang mga sinabi niya sa akin

"Mahal kong Ernesto, alam kong tulog mo'y malalim
'Di na 'ko nagpaalam, 'di na kita ginising
Salamat nga pala sa pasalubong mong kalamay
At sa pinakamasayang gabi ng aking buhay
Nu'ng iniwan ko ang baryo natin, ang akala ko

Isang tunay na pag-ibig ang matatagpuan ko
Hinanap kung saan-saan at kung kani-kanino
'Di ko inakalang ito ang kahahantungan ko
Imbis na ako'y sagipin, itinulak sa bangin
Ito pala'ng ibig sabihin ng kapit sa patalim
Kung mabaho sabunin, kung makati gamutin
Kung hindi na masikmura ay ibaling ang tingin
Kahit ako ay bayaran at kaladkaring babaeng

Alam ang amoy ng laway ng iba't ibang babae
Isa lang ang kaya kong sa 'yo'y maipagmalaki
Ikaw lang ang bukod-tanging hinalikan ko sa labi
Gusto ko mang manatili sa 'yong mga yakap
Ako ma'y natutuwa dahil ako'y iyong nahanap
Wala na yatang walis ang makakalinis ng kalat
At ang katulad ko sa 'yo ay 'di karapat-dapat
Pinangarap kong sa altar, ako'y iyong ihatid

Ngunit sa dami ng pait, ang puso ko'y namanhid
'Di ko makakalimutan ang pabaon mong halik
Pero pakiusap, huwag ka na sana pang babalik
Regalo ng Maykapal ang ikaw ay makilala
Salamat sa ala-ala, nagmamahal, Magda"

Magdalena, ano'ng problema?
Alam naman natin na dati kang nena
At sa iyong ama, ikaw ay prinsesa

Ito'y kwento ng isang babae

songs.lyrics:
Oh, kay gandang pagmasdan
Ang iyong mga mata
Kumikinang-kinang
'Di ko maintindihan

Ang iyong mga tingin
Labis ang mga ningning
Langit ay bumaba

songs.title: Someone New
songs.lyrics:
Are you thinking of someone new while I am thinking of you?
The night grows cold and I am left with memories of blue

songs.title: Umaasa
songs.lyrics:
Umaasa pa rin kahit na malabo nang magbalik
Ang init ng iyong yakap at halik

songs.title: PROVENZA
songs.lyrics:
Baby, ¿qué más? Hace rato que no sé na' de ti
Estaba con alguien, pero ya estoy free
Puesta pa' revivir viejos tiempos

songs.title: TQG (feat. Shakira)
songs.lyrics:
Te fuiste diciendo que me superaste
Y te conseguiste nueva novia
Lo que ella no sabe es que tú todavía me estás viendo todas las historias

songs.title: DESPECHÁ
songs.lyrics:
Baby, no me llames, que yo estoy ocupá' olvidando tus males
Ya decidí que esta noche se sale
Con todas mis motomamis, con toda mi gente

songs.title: BIZCOCHITO
songs.lyrics:
Yo no soy ni voy a ser tu bizcochito
Tengo to' lo que me hace falta, chiquito

songs.title: Hawái
songs.lyrics:
Puede que no te haga falta na', aparentemente na'
Hawái de vacaciones, mis felicitaciones
Muy lindo en Instagram lo que posteas

songs.title: Sobrio
songs.lyrics:
Quiero pedir perdón pero sobrio no puedo
Bebiendo te llamo y te digo te quiero

songs.title: Todo de Ti
songs.lyrics:
El olor de tu perfume en mi piel
Me gusta todo de ti
De arriba a abajo baby no hay nada que cambiar

songs.title: Desesperados (feat. Chencho Corleone)
songs.lyrics:
Andamos desesperados por vernos
Una noche de perreo eterno

songs.title: Ella Baila Sola (with Eslabon Armado)
songs.lyrics:
Compa, ¿qué le parece esa morra?
La que anda bailando sola me gusta pa' mí
Bella, ella sabe que está buena

songs.title: LADY GAGA
songs.lyrics:
Dom Pérignon Lady Gaga brindando en la mesa
Todo lo que quiero la vida me lo regresa

songs.title: LUNA (feat. ATL Jacob)
songs.albumTitle: MOR, No Le Temas a la Oscuridad
songs.lyrics:
A veces pienso en ti cuando miro la luna
Como tú en este mundo no hay ninguna

songs.title: Classy 101 (feat. Young Miko)
songs.albumTitle: MOR, No Le Temas a la Oscuridad
songs.lyrics:
Ella se ve tan classy, pero perrea hasta el piso
Ferxxo con la baby haciendo lo indeciso

songs.title: Se Preparó
songs.lyrics:
Se preparó, se puso linda, a su amiga llamaba
Salió a la calle dispuesta a olvidar al que no la valoraba

songs.title: Caramelo
songs.lyrics:
Tú me provocas como un dulce caramelo
Bailando suave que me llevas hasta el cielo

songs.title: Despacito (feat. Daddy Yankee)
songs.lyrics:
Despacito, quiero respirar tu cuello despacito
Deja que te diga cosas al oído
Para que te acuerdes si no estás conmigo

songs.title: Échame La Culpa (with Demi Lovato)
songs.lyrics:
No eres tú, no eres tú, soy yo
Échame la culpa a mí

songs.title: Envolver
songs.lyrics:
Dime cómo hacemos, si tú me deseas y yo a ti también
Te va a gustar el juego cuando nos envolvamos bien

songs.title: BELLAKEO (with Peso Pluma)
songs.lyrics:
Esto es pa' que bailemos pegao en la disco
Bellakeo violento hasta el amanecer

songs.title: Bailando (feat. Descemer Bueno & Gente De Zona)
songs.lyrics:
Bailando, bailando, tu cuerpo y el mío llenando el vacío
Subiendo y bajando, una locura que quema mi piel

songs.title: Hero
songs.lyrics:
I can be your hero, baby
I can kiss away the pain
I will stand by you forever

songs.title: Livin' la Vida Loca
songs.lyrics:
Upside, inside out, she's livin' la vida loca
She'll push and pull you down, livin' la vida loca

songs.title: Vente Pa' Ca (feat. Maluma)
songs.lyrics:
Si tú quieres nos bañamos, si tú quieres nos soplamos
Vente pa' ca, vente pa' ca

songs.title: La Bachata
songs.lyrics:
Te estoy llamando borracho pa' decirte
Que te quiero todavía, que me mata la melancolía
Y bailo la bachata con tu recuerdo

songs.title: El Merengue (with Marshmello)
songs.lyrics:
Dije que te olvidé pero mentí
Bailando el merengue pensando en ti

songs.title: Tacones Rojos
songs.lyrics:
Hay una chica en mi ventana con tacones rojos
Baila alegre que me ilumina los ojos

songs.title: Pareja del Año (with Myke Towers)
songs.lyrics:
Si tú me das la oportunidad seríamos la pareja del año
Un amor bonito que no nos haga daño

songs.title: Vida de Rico
songs.lyrics:
Yo no tengo pa' darte ni un peso
Pero sí puedo darte mis besos
Pa' sacarte yo tengo poquito pero es una vida de rico

songs.title: Tutu (with Pedro Capó)
songs.lyrics:
No hay nadie como tú-tú, nadie me cuida como tú-tú
Me tienes loco con ese meneo

songs.title: Chulo pt. 2 (with Tokischa & Bad Gyal)
songs.lyrics:
Tiene una cara que parece un ángel
Pero en la disco se transforma, qué chulo

songs.title: wiggy
songs.lyrics:
It's Young Miko baby, gettin' jiggy with it
Rompiendo el bajo de la bocina

songs.title: Shakira: Bzrp Music Sessions, Vol. 53
songs.lyrics:
Una loba como yo no está pa' tipos como tú
A ti te quedé grande y por eso estás con una igualita que tú
Las mujeres ya no lloran, las mujeres facturan

songs.title: Quevedo: Bzrp Music Sessions, Vol. 52 (Quédate)
songs.lyrics:
Quédate, que las noches sin ti duelen
Tengo en la mente las poses y todos los gemidos
Que no quiero nada si no es contigo

songs.title: telepatía
songs.albumTitle: Sin Miedo (del Amor y Otros Demonios)
songs.lyrics:
Quién lo diría que se puede hacer el amor por telepatía
La luna está llena, mi cama vacía
Aunque estés lejos te siento aquí todavía

songs.title: Moonlight
songs.albumTitle: Sin Miedo (del Amor y Otros Demonios)
songs.lyrics:
I just wanna get high with my lover in the moonlight
Veo la luna brillar y me acuerdo de ti

songs.title: El Perdón (with Enrique Iglesias)
songs.lyrics:
Dime si es verdad que ya no me quieres
Yo sigo aquí esperando por ti
Es que yo sin ti no puedo vivir

songs.title: Hasta el Amanecer
songs.lyrics:
Cómo tú te llamas, yo no sé
De dónde llegaste, ni pregunté
Lo único que sé es que quiero bailar contigo hasta el amanecer

songs.title: Pepas
songs.lyrics:
No me importa lo que de mí se diga
Viva usted su vida, que yo vivo la mía
Pepa y agua pa' la seca, to' el mundo en pastilla' en la discoteca

songs.title: Calma (Remix with Pedro Capó)
songs.lyrics:
Vamos pa' la playa, pa' curarte el alma
Cierra la pantalla, abre la medalla
Todo con calma

songs.title: Propuesta Indecente
songs.lyrics:
Una aventura es más divertida si huele a peligro
Si te invito una copa y me acerco a tu boca
¿Te parece una propuesta indecente?

songs.title: Eres Mía
songs.lyrics:
No te hagas la loca, que aunque estés con él tú sigues siendo mía
Tu corazón me pertenece

songs.title: Vivir Mi Vida
songs.lyrics:
Voy a reír, voy a bailar, vivir mi vida lalalalá
Voy a reír, voy a gozar, vivir mi vida lalalalá
A veces llega la lluvia para limpiar las heridas

songs.title: Valió la Pena
songs.lyrics:
Valió la pena lo que era necesario para estar contigo amor
Tú eres una bendición

songs.title: All The Small Things
songs.lyrics:
All the small things
True care, truth brings
I'll take one lift, your ride, best trip
Always I know you'll be at my show
Watching, waiting, commiserating

songs.title: What's My Age Again?
songs.lyrics:
Nobody likes you when you're twenty-three
And you still act like you're in freshman year
What the hell is wrong with me?

songs.title: I Miss You
songs.lyrics:
Don't waste your time on me, you're already the voice inside my head
I miss you, I miss you
Where are you and I'm so sorry

songs.title: Smells Like Teen Spirit
songs.lyrics:
With the lights out, it's less dangerous
Here we are now, entertain us
I feel stupid and contagious
Here we are now, entertain us
A mulatto, an albino, a mosquito, my libido

songs.title: Come As You Are
songs.lyrics:
Come as you are, as you were, as I want you to be
As a friend, as a friend, as an old enemy
Take your time, hurry up, the choice is yours, don't be late

songs.title: Everlong
songs.lyrics:
Hello, I've waited here for you
Everlong
Tonight I throw myself into
And out of the red, out of her head she sang
And I wonder when I sing along with you
If everything could ever feel this real forever

songs.title: Best of You
songs.lyrics:
Is someone getting the best, the best, the best of you?
Has someone taken your faith? Its real, the pain you feel
You trust, you must confess

songs.title: Californication
songs.lyrics:
Psychic spies from China try to steal your mind's elation
And little girls from Sweden dream of silver screen quotation
And if you want these kind of dreams it's Californication

songs.title: Under the Bridge
songs.lyrics:
Sometimes I feel like I don't have a partner
Sometimes I feel like my only friend
Is the city I live in, the City of Angels
Lonely as I am, together we cry

songs.title: ILYSB
songs.lyrics:
Ain't never felt this way
Can't think about nobody else but you
'Cause baby I, I love you so bad
My heart hurts so good

songs.title: Malibu Nights
songs.lyrics:
I've got way too much time to be this hurt
Somebody help, it's getting worse
What do you do with a broken heart?

songs.title: Swim
songs.lyrics:
I can see the waves coming in, baby
Deep end, let's see how deep you can swim

songs.title: Into It
songs.lyrics:
Tell me that you're into it
Late night driving through the city lights

songs.title: Apocalypse
songs.lyrics:
Got the music in you, baby, tell me why
You've been locked in here forever and you just can't say goodbye
Your lips, my lips, apocalypse

songs.title: K.
songs.lyrics:
I remember when I first noticed that you liked me back
We were sitting down in a restaurant and you smiled

songs.title: Are You Bored Yet? (feat. Clairo)
songs.lyrics:
Cause we could stay at home and watch the sunset
But I can't help from asking, are you bored yet?

songs.title: Scrawny
songs.lyrics:
I'm a scrawny motherfucker with a cool haircut
I can't say I'm proud of every move I made

songs.title: I Love You So
songs.lyrics:
I'm gonna pack my things and leave you behind
This feeling's old and I know that I've made up my mind
I hope you're okay, but you're the reason I'm not
I love you so, please let me go

songs.title: She's Gonna Leave You
songs.lyrics:
She's gonna leave you, she's gonna break your heart
Don't let her tear your world apart

songs.title: Dreams
songs.lyrics:
Now here you go again, you say you want your freedom
Well, who am I to keep you down?
Thunder only happens when it's raining
Players only love you when they're playing

songs.title: The Chain
songs.lyrics:
And if you don't love me now, you will never love me again
I can still hear you saying you would never break the chain

songs.title: Back in Black
songs.lyrics:
Back in black, I hit the sack
I've been too long, I'm glad to be back
Yes, I'm let loose from the noose
That's kept me hanging about

songs.title: Highway to Hell
songs.lyrics:
No stop signs, speed limit
Nobody's gonna slow me down
I'm on the highway to hell

songs.title: Stairway to Heaven
songs.lyrics:
There's a lady who's sure all that glitters is gold
And she's buying a stairway to heaven
When she gets there she knows, if the stores are all closed
With a word she can get what she came for

songs.title: Immigrant Song
songs.lyrics:
Ah-ah, ah!
We come from the land of the ice and snow
From the midnight sun where the hot springs flow
The hammer of the gods will drive our ships to new lands

songs.title: Wish You Were Here
songs.albumTitle: The Dark Side of the Moon
songs.lyrics:
How I wish, how I wish you were here
We're just two lost souls swimming in a fish bowl, year after year
Running over the same old ground, what have we found?
The same old fears, wish you were here

songs.title: Comfortably Numb
songs.albumTitle: The Dark Side of the Moon
songs.lyrics:
Hello, is there anybody in there?
Just nod if you can hear me
Is there anyone home?
There is no pain, you are receding
A distant ship's smoke on the horizon
I have become comfortably numb

songs.title: Enter Sandman
songs.lyrics:
Say your prayers, little one, don't forget, my son
To include everyone
Exit light, enter night
Take my hand, we're off to never-never land

songs.title: Nothing Else Matters
songs.lyrics:
So close, no matter how far
Couldn't be much more from the heart
Forever trusting who we are
And nothing else matters

songs.title: With or Without You
songs.lyrics:
See the stone set in your eyes
See the thorn twist in your side
I'll wait for you
Sleight of hand and twist of fate
On a bed of nails she makes me wait
And I wait without you
With or without you

songs.title: Beautiful Day
songs.lyrics:
It's a beautiful day, don't let it get away
It's a beautiful day
Touch me, take me to that other place
